revision_scope: Parley game-rules capture only replaced on 2026-10-06. Other scenes and the historical workflow below retain their earlier provenance. The replacement has per-capture provenance and does not establish an exact CK3 patch.

workflow.assistant: Defined visible feature evidence and reviewed the selected captures.
workflow.user: Chose characters, framing and final images; performed manual capture steps.
workflow.capture_build: Selected during 2026-09-30-game-rc3 publication preparation. Screenshots alone do not establish exact loaded payload hashes.
workflow.scope: Publication captures do not repeat closed development tests. A screenshot establishes only visible content, not completion of an unshown treaty.
workflow.requested_capture_settings: 100% UI scale and maximum graphics; image dimensions are 1920x1080. Graphics settings are not independently proven by the images.
workflow.presentation: Selected PNG originals are retained without cropping, recompression or changes to scores.
workflow.manual_steps: Further capture actions, if needed, remain one user action at a time; no computer-use automation.

path_conventions: Gallery manifest paths are relative to the Parley repository root. Scene and completed-capture file paths are relative to their owning mod repository root.
historical_material: Retired temporary screenshots and the earlier RC2 smoke candidate are not selected. Their historical evidence remains outside these publication galleries.

scenes.purpose: Show a complete deal with both term columns and the counterpart acceptance score.
visible_requirements: Player gold and prestige offered for fealty
scenes.caption_brief_en: Offer gold and prestige in exchange for fealty, with acceptance shown at the table.

scenes.purpose: Show that other rulers initiate offers and the player can respond.
visible_requirements: 322 gold offered for a favor owed
scenes.caption_brief_en: Other rulers make offers of their own: gold today in exchange for a favor later.

scenes.purpose: Show marriage, alliance, gold and fealty together in an AGOT proposal.
visible_requirements: Visible +1 acceptance; the proposal is not proof of completed vassalization
scenes.caption_brief_en: Bring dynastic diplomacy to AGOT: combine marriage, alliance, gold and fealty in one proposal.

scenes.purpose: Show all eight Parley 1.2.1 game rules, including Scaled term valuation and the separate threat strength and frequency settings.
visible_requirements: Advanced terms, Scaled valuation, prestige and piety settings
Separate threat strength and five-year threat frequency settings
AI-to-AI treaties and offers sent to the player
scenes.caption_brief_en: Parley 1.2.1 game rules: Scaled valuation and a five-year threat cooldown selected (not defaults).

scenes.purpose: Show MCA sorting when choosing a potential spouse from other courts.
visible_requirements: Selected own candidate on the left
Other-court candidate list with descending 134, 133 and 95 scores
scenes.caption_brief_en: Compare potential spouses from other courts, sorted by MCA score.

scenes.purpose: Show the same MCA sorting when choosing a candidate from the player court.
visible_requirements: Selected foreign candidate on the right
scenes.caption_brief_en: Rank candidates from your own court when arranging a marriage with another ruler.

scenes.purpose: Show the adapter contribution in the native AGOT marriage picker.
visible_requirements: Dynastic prestige +35, inheritable qualities +30 and dragonrider potential +30
Explanatory tooltip distinguishes potential from AI acceptance and guaranteed outcomes
scenes.caption_brief_en: AGOT candidate scoring, including dragonrider potential and a detailed score breakdown.
